title: 2:1 Multiplexer
statement: Implement a 2:1 multiplexer that selects between two 8-bit inputs based on a single select line. The module must drive the output combinationally with no registers or clocks. The select signal must be stable during evaluation. This circuit is a classic data-path selector used in ALU and routing logic.
module_signature: module mux_2to1(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input sel, output [7:0] y);
behavior: If sel is 0, y must equal a; if sel is 1, y must equal b.
No sequential elements; behavior must be purely combinational.
All bits of y must update immediately after inputs change.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use any clocks or sequential constructs.
hint: Use a single conditional assignment or bitwise mask.
